discussion:
# Principle

Systems (infrastructure, operating systems, applications, identities, credentials and data) are continually and centrally identified and documented.

# Indicators of Good Practice

Not effective:
- No approved asset inventory mechanism is in place.
- Asset inventory records are maintained manually with no automated discovery capability.

Partially effective:
- An approved asset inventory mechanism is deployed but does not cover all network segments or asset types.
- Automated discovery scans to detect new and changed physical and non-physical assets occur on a schedule but reconciliation with the approved inventory is manual or inconsistent.

Fully effective:
- An approved asset inventory mechanism which supports automated discovery is deployed to cover all applicable assets and network segments.
- Discovery runs on a regular schedule defined by the organisation and new or changed physical or non-physical assets that are detected are reconciled with the approved inventory.
title: Use an approved asset inventory mechanism that supports automated discovery to detect new and changed physical and non-physical assets.
